title: Write features/daw/collection-folder.feature and its steps; watch them fail
description:
## Intent

Specs first for collection export.

## Scope

- `features/daw/collection-folder.feature` with every scenario of the stories apricitus-2f5268, apricitus-b0281e and apricitus-325160.
- Steps in the shared `features/daw/STEPS.md`: a temp library (`apricity_data::Library::create`) with samples, clips and a collection (Crate + CrateItem records until the Collection rename), moving and removing items; reading `.adg` pads reuses M1's steps, reading `.alc` reuses the shared ones.
- Level check compares against `apricity explain` of a score holding a drum kit of the same clips (observable, not internal).

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test conformance
```
Scenarios fail for the right reason (no `--collection`); output in a comment.

## Release

`test(<this task id>): specs for collection export`. Not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M1's CLI task (apricitus-c1a8b5) and M3's CLI task (apricitus-2547a3).
